Sophia: Orion marketplace ops just updated: EU rack lead time now ~10w instead of 6w. This breaks the Dedicated capacity commitment for our marketplace launch. Need triage. :frowning:
Mateo: Which resvs are affected?
Sophia: Bucket EU-marketplace-dedicated. Sample resv: `RESV-99412` and `RESV-99413`. Partner cites port congestion + customs backlog.
Liam: Pulled the ledger: `RESV-99412` 6x A100 racks 2024-11-05 -> 2025-01-14. `RESV-99413` 2x A10G racks 2024-11-12 -> 2025-01-20.
Rachel: Product note 0000Our public marketplace announcement is planned for 11/15. If capacity won't be there, we either shrink offering or delay. What's minimum workable footprint?
Mateo: Quick ideas: 1) Ask Orion for split shipment + premium freight 2) Reassign from non-prod buffer (needs partner/legal) 3) Launch with limited zones and explicit "staged availability" copy.
Liam: Ops feasibility: reassign is blocked by contract lock on those resv IDs. Cross-region fallback possible (serve from US with higher latency) but not ideal.
Sophia: Setting a 14:30 UTC call with Orion rep to request split shipments and a written amendment to allow 2-rack reassign on premium.
Ops-bot: Event created: "Orion capacity triage" 2024-10-09 14:30 UTC.
Mateo: I'll draft fallback marketplace copy that lists zones and staged ETA. Rachel, can you review?
Rachel: Yes. If no partner confirmation by Fri 17:00 UTC, we pivot to pilot-only preview and pause public announce.
Liam: Ran dry-run reassign: blocked by `ERR_CONTRACT_LOCK clause 4.2`. If we get amendment, reassign works.
Sophia: Action items: Partnerships to secure amendment/expedite by EOD. Ops to stand by. Product to prepare scaled copy. Will update after call. :thumbsup:
